title: Uncertainty-Aware Resource Orchestration for Agentic AI Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.05392v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agentic artificial intelligence (AI) systems powered by large language models (LLMs) execute as autonomous multi-step pipelines that dynamically invoke tools, integrate observations into memory, and iterate until a task is resolved or a resource budget is exhausted. Unlike classical workflows with fixed graphs, the aggregate compute, bandwidth, and end-to-end latency demands of such pipelines are unknown at dispatch time: they emerge at runtime from intermediate observations and stochastic token sampling, yielding heavy-tailed, multi-modal random variables. This unpredictability forces infrastructure orchestrators into a dilemma: under-provisioning risks mid-execution throttling and deadline violations, while over-provisioning wastes scarce edge or cloud capacity. translated_title: 面向智能体AI系统的不确定性感知资源编排
translated_abstract: 由大语言模型（LLM）驱动的智能体人工智能（AI）系统以自主的多步骤流水线形式执行，动态调用工具、将观测结果整合进记忆，并不断迭代，直到任务完成或资源预算耗尽。与具有固定图结构的经典工作流不同，此类流水线的总体计算、带宽和端到端延迟需求在调度时是未知的：它们在运行时由中间观测结果和随机token采样涌现而来，形成重尾、多峰的随机变量。这种不可预测性使基础设施编排器陷入两难：资源供给不足可能导致执行中途限流和违反截止期限，而过度供给则会浪费稀缺的边缘或云端容量。现有调度器需要完全已知的流水线图，而边缘资源管理方法依赖参数化或平稳的需求模型，两者都不适用于未知的、非平稳的需求特性……
tldr: 本文提出了一种不确定性感知的资源编排方法，解决大语言模型驱动的智能体AI系统因运行时资源需求呈重尾、多峰且不可预测而导致的调度难题，避免资源供给不足或过度供给。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an uncertainty-aware resource orchestration approach for LLM-powered agentic AI systems, addressing the unpredictable heavy-tailed, multi-modal runtime resource demands to avoid both under-provisioning and over-provisioning.
